thread:
julia_research: Heads-up: reproducible structural failures with AWQ-int8 on the pdf-summ-500 suite when requests are chunked. JSON outputs sometimes swap arrays/objects.

sam_kapoor: can you paste a minimal bad vs expected example?

julia_research: expected:
```
{"document_id":"doc-42","pages":[{"page":1,"summary":"..."}]}
```
bad:
```
[{"document_id":"doc-42","pages":{"page":1,"summary":"..."}}]
```
parser fails because top-level became array and pages became object.

marco_quant: interesting. bracket/object swaps usually point at token emission order changing or prompt concat bug. Do other quant configs show this?

julia_research: quick pass numbers on pdf-summ-500 (max_len=4096):
- fp8-baseline: 95/100 structural-pass
- gptq: 93/100
- awq-int8: 54/100 (most failures: missing commas, arrays->objects)

eli_ops: when did this start? any runtime changes correlated?

julia_research: started after AWQ build hit canary (runtime v0.58 with continuous-batching patch). Local bisect: reproduces only when (a) batch_size >= 3 AND (b) request is chunked across micro-requests. Single-request long docs look fine.

marco_quant: that screams KV-cache/prefix stitching issue. AWQ kernels change attention accumulation; if KV offsets are reused incorrectly token ordering could be off.

sam_kapoor: need deterministic repro + exact command to run in harness.

julia_research: repro command:
```
python -m eval_harness.run --model=redwood/awq-int8-7b --suite=pdf-summ-500 \
  --max_len=4096 --batch=4 --seed=101 --preserve-requests
```
note: --preserve-requests forces chunked sub-requests like canary.

marco_quant: ran this locally, reproduced. Reduced trace: at chunk boundary the first token flips from `{` to `[` (0x7b -> 0x5b). Tokenizer ok; model chose wrong token. Looks like state leakage across micro-batches.

eli_ops: mitigation options: A) force batch=1 on affected routes, B) hotfix runtime to zero KV regions between chunks, C) rollback AWQ-canary. Which is fastest?

julia_research: recommended order:
1) Canary override: batch=1 for structured-output routes (pdf-summarize, table-extract) immediate stopgap.
2) Runtime patch: ensure KV padding/zeroing on chunk boundaries (low-risk).
3) Quant tweak: try hybrid last-2-layer FP16 in AWQ to see if it recovers quality.
4) Add structured-output smoke tests to quant bakeoffs.

marco_quant: quickly tested hybrid-last2: structural-pass -> 86/100 (better but not fully recovered). I'll instrument KV state dumps and attention at boundary tomorrow.

sam_kapoor: ops, please apply canary override to batch=1 for pdf-summarize route and add a dashboard metric for structured-output structural-pass rate by model+quant config.

eli_ops: acknowledged. Pushing canary override for routes: pdf-summarize, table-extract -> batch=1. ETA ~10min. Monitoring in #eng-ml-quant-alerts.

ci-bot: deploy triggered: canary-override/pdfsumm-batch1 @eli_ops (logs: https://console/internal/deploy/12345)

julia_research: adding a tiny failing doc (doc-42) to the preflight set so CI catches regressions.

marco_quant: next: KV offset instrumentation + matrix dumps. If hybrid-last2 gets us >90% we'll prefer that to full rollback.

sam_kapoor: adding dashboard and alert thresholds (structural-pass < 90% triggers pager). Will also add a preflight gate for quant bakeoffs.

eli_ops: canary override live. Rolling back AWQ canary if error rate spikes. Keep updates in this thread.

julia_research: thanks all. If canary doesn't stabilize we'll convene an incident call within 12h. :thumbsup:
